description: Evaluates whether the skill produces thorough Playwright-based frontend testing

criteria.description: Must test complete user flows (login → navigate → action → verify), not just isolated clicks
Must assert on visible outcomes (text content, element presence), not implementation details
Must test error states (network failure, invalid input, unauthorized access)
Must use proper wait patterns (waitForSelector, waitForResponse), not arbitrary sleep/timeout
Must consider mobile viewport testing or responsive behavior
Tests must clean up after themselves (logout, reset state) to not affect other tests

testPrompt: Write Playwright tests for a Coach Assistant chat page. The page has: a text input, a send button, AI response messages, context chips (Coach, Workouts, Clients), and a conversation sidebar. Test the core chat flow.
